correctness.rationale: The full source theorem and corollary were checked at the printed hypotheses and definitions. Coordinate g-frames on complex ell2 are Parseval and globally alternate dual. Each singleton local pair (1/j,j) is a genuine alternate dual frame pair on C, with no uniform local bounds. The induced vectors (e_j/j,j e_j) respectively lack a positive frame lower bound and a finite Bessel bound; the latter also sends the valid input (1/j) outside ell2. The source corollary is thereby false. Under common local upper bounds the induced Bessel estimates and bounded duality equivalence follow, and testing e_j proves the exact scalar-diagonal seminormalization threshold.

value.rationale: The local-to-global induced-duality equivalence is a main structural objective of the paper. The failure persists with two identical Parseval g-frames and local reconstructions whose block operator Q equals identity, so it is not an artifact of a bad original frame or an unbounded reconstruction operator. The induced analysis itself is undefined on a legitimate ell2 input, invalidating the claimed global dual-frame representation. The scalar model supplies the exact necessity-and-sufficiency boundary of uniform seminormalization, a practically relevant stability requirement for independently chosen coefficient-space dual frames.
